Resolves #21531

Caches the initial out-render promise on `session.holdPromise` in `Neo.grid.plugin.CellEditing#holdEdit` so overlapping column-lock callers await the active `repaintRow(editor.parent)` barrier before re-sorting sub-grid bodies, and clears `session.holdPromise` on the final `releaseEdit()`.

Prescription checked: `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs` — owns the concern (`session`, `holdEdit`, and `releaseEdit` are private/protected plugin state owned solely by `CellEditing`). Change class: `restoration` (`fix`); `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + Engine Tests ran`.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright browser e2e in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs` + unit simulation in `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellEditingToggle.spec.mjs`, both verified red on `dev` and green on `head`) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 + grid browser e2e per #19777).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs` (`an open edit survives two columns changing locked in one tick with its draft and focus`) + `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellEditingToggle.spec.mjs` (`overlapping holdEdit calls await the first in-flight repaintRow and re-embed once on final release`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellEditingToggle.spec.mjs` (`overlapping holdEdit calls await the first in-flight repaintRow and re-embed once on final release` — verifies `session.held` `2 -> 1 -> 0`, `repaintCalls === 0` on first release and `1` on final release) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellEditingToggle.spec.mjs` (`holdEdit resolves cleanly with no session or unembodied editor and refreshes holdPromise per cycle`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Added browser e2e arm in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs` (`unlockBothEnds` in `gridDriver.mjs`) per the grid browser-e2e requirement (#19777).

## Test Evidence
- **Local browser e2e isolation (`npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`):**
  - **Red on `dev` (`origin/dev` `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`):** fails with user-visible focus loss (`Error: the editor keeps focus in c0` — `editingIn(page, 'c0', recordId)` stays `false` across the 5s poll when `c0.locked = null; c39.locked = null` run in one tick while editing `c0` with `'draft'`, because the second `holdEdit()` resolves immediately and `view.updateBodies()` destroys `bodyStart` before `startRow`'s `repaintRow` flips `editor.mounted` to `false`, so re-embedding into the center body never fires `mounted` / `onEditorReprojected`).
  - **Green at head (`431875919d`):** `7/7` passed (`an open edit survives two columns changing locked in one tick with its draft and focus` passes in `755ms`, preserving `'draft'`, active `<input>` focus, and live `Escape` discard).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; both unit (`Engine Tests / unit`) and browser e2e (`E2E (engine tier)`) run pre-merge in CI.

## Commits
- `c9fa6debef` — cache active out-render promise on `session.holdPromise` across overlapping `holdEdit` / `releaseEdit` calls + unit coverage
- `431875919d` — add browser e2e in `CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs` for two-column same-tick lock transition + wrap `@summary` lines to 120 cols

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21531 (Design authority: `holdEdit`'s "`@returns {Promise<void>} settles once the editor is out of the DOM`"), the changed files (`src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellEditingToggle.spec.mjs`), `dev`'s `holdEdit` / `releaseEdit` / `repaintRow`, and the only caller, `GridContainer#onColumnLockChange` (`src/grid/Container.mjs`, its `holdEdit` await and the `finally` that releases).
